scope: Active SD study including SD models stored in version1800. Prior Reforged/DE work preserved separately, excluded here.
semanticCaution: Measured coverage is not semantic completion. Direct labels, strict transfers and pending interpretation are counted separately. A physical component may contain several semantic parts or only one piece of an assembly.
geometryPolicy: Committed exports omit vertex positions, mesh face indices and game texture pixels. UV coordinates, measurements, labels and provenance are derived research outputs.
